checks.reason: Matches C3/D1/E1-E4/B1-B3 verbatim. The ranges are nonempty, r>2 is forced by theta>1/2, and nu<=p<r holds. For Gamma=0 we have H_I={0}, T=0 and S_R_all=0. P=S_F(1/delta) has norm >=1 and grows only polynomially (G_B<=4B), so GL3 holds trivially. The 'alpha<d or alpha=d=1' clause is carried implicitly by 'H:homog'.

checks.reason: raw-block-event-lower Section 7 (21)-(22) gives P_glob(mB+u,mB)=S_F(u)U_{X_m^full}(u,0) at fixed delta,B,N, with the true last clock tau=ell_N. E2(5) splits the full block into head plus Q_J residual on the same W. The composition and submultiplicativity (E (22)) follow. The (21)-(22) identity is noise-only and does not use the Psi/positive-ground-family/eligible-mask hypotheses of the lower theorem. The target does not invoke them, and B1-B3 review item 2 records this fit. No residual-only or law-only replacement appears.

checks.reason: Norm measurability follows from countable dense unit states, as in raw-block Sections 4-5. ||P||>=1 holds because pi_C of the driver vanishes (fixed-mask (8)) and the e_disp column gives tau(t)e_disp=(1,0). Finiteness: take B=1, J=0, Phi=0. B1 gives delta log||P||^2 <= 4C_theta + eta_1 Y^nu, and D1 at J=0 is finite for every delta<1.

checks.reason: Rate(0)=0 because beta(0)=0, which gives S>=0. From S4, lambda(L)<=max(1,||L||), and |I|=1 gives L1<=Lr, so Rate<=1+||T|| ||Phi||. Then max_x(2||T||x-x^2/2)=2||T||^2, which gives the stated bound. The non-identification disclaimer is present.

checks.claim: GL2c tail bound 2^J exp((C0-M_B^2/8)/delta) E exp(eta_B Y^nu/delta), with M_B=M0 B^m, m>3nu/(2-nu), and the cutoff eventually satisfied
checks.reason: Head/residual independence (E4) factorizes the expectation. The seam inequality with C=C1 B^(3nu), M=M_B, x=||Phi||>M_B gives exponent <= -M_B^2/8 - x^2/8. The remaining integral (2 pi delta)^(-J/2) times the integral of exp(-|phi|^2/(8 delta)) equals 2^J exactly. M_B^(2-nu)/(4C1 B^(3nu)) is proportional to B^(m(2-nu)-3nu), which tends to infinity. C1=0 needs no division. For J=0 the tail is empty, with log 0 = -infinity. No time-block independence is used. D1 finiteness holds at fixed eta_B.

checks.claim: GL3: 0 <= limsup delta log E||P||^2 <= S_R_all, with order delta to 0, then J to infinity, then B to infinity, the same left side throughout, and B3 threshold s>r(3+m)/(r-nu)
checks.reason: Use log(bulk+tail) <= log 2 + max. At fixed J, delta*(J/2)log(1/(2 pi delta)) and delta log b_J tend to 0. E3 gives lim_J limsup_delta delta log R = 0 at fixed M_B. D1(4)-(5) remove the eta_B residual term as J tends to infinity. B3 with K_B=B^s sends limsup_delta E_delta(B,M_B) to 0, and C0-M_B^2/8 tends to -infinity. The left side is independent of B and J, so the iterated bounds are legitimate. There is no diagonal, no J-dependent eta and no compactness on unbounded balls.

minor: Symbol collision: GL2 uses C0=4C_theta. D1 (upper-residual-exponential (1)) uses C0=C_B(2/B)^(1/p-1/r), which enters GL3 through D1(4). The falsification and target text also say 'calibrate C0 against exact chi-square tails', but those calibrations use weight C=0, not the constant 4C_theta. Renaming one of these would avoid misreading.

The target fixes the GL2a constants but does not write out how they are derived. Suggest stating it: B1 with ||H_m+x_m||<=a_m+v_m; the two-entry power mean (2^(nu-1)); delta*n<=2/B; power mean with exponent r/nu on a_m^nu and p/nu on v_m^nu, with equality when nu=p; C_B<=32B^(3-1/r). The constants are correct as stated.

The raw-restart fit could say explicitly that only the noise-only identity in raw-block Section 7 (21)-(22) at fixed delta,B,N is used. That excludes the Psi-dependent D_m^+ shift and the positive ground family/eligible-mask hypotheses. It could also say that m_R=eta_R^2 satisfies that note's mask conditions, and that its nonzero-Gamma hypothesis is matched by the separate Gamma=0 free case.
GL2c should state its quantifiers explicitly: every integer B satisfying the cutoff inequality (every B if C1=0) and every 0<delta<min(1,1/B).
'zero-started compatible residual paths' in GL2a is undefined. B1 needs only zero-started C^theta paths, so 'compatible' (presumably pi_C x_m=0) can be dropped or defined.

'separable Young-image law' in GL1 is vague. The endpoint lies in S_F(L)(I+K(F)), and Borel measurability of the norm follows from countable dense states. The ||P||>=1 baseline should cite fixed-mask (8) and the e_disp column.
The S_R_all bound uses ||T|| as the H_I->L^r(I;K(F)) norm together with L1<=L^r on the unit interval. Stating this would make the constant 2+2||T||^2 self-contained.
The seam hypothesis 1<nu is stronger than needed (nu<=2 suffices). This is harmless.
The threshold-control script hard-codes the closed-form ratio 2B^((m-15)/3) rather than computing M_B^(2-nu)/(4C1B^(3nu)) directly. It is an exact algebraic restatement, not an independent test.
